description: This is a PHP test class for the DefaultTimesheetAPI, which is part of the OrangeHRM system. The class contains unit tests for API endpoints related to timesheet management, including methods to test retrieving a timesheet, deleting, and updating, with some tests expecting not implemented exceptions.

classes.name: DefaultTimesheetAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the DefaultTimesheetAPI endpoints within the OrangeHRM system, focusing on timesheet retrieval, deletion, and updates.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of a single timesheet entry via the DefaultTimesheetAPI.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetOne
methods.description: Provides data sets for the testGetOne method, loading test cases from a YAML file.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Ensures that calling delete on the API throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Ensures that getting validation rules for delete throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Ensures that calling update on the API throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Ensures that getting validation rules for update throws a not implemented exception.
